name: Niiyama Sakura
source:
"A naive, airheaded housewife"

She has a very trusting personality and doesn’t know how to be suspicious of others. To put it bluntly, maybe she’s a little naive?

Lately, She's been worried that she's not getting enough exercise, so she decided to start taking yoga classes.

She doesn’t have any particular complaints about her life with her husband, but is worried because she wants to have a baby soon, yet she just can’t seem to conceive.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yoga/chara.html]official site[/url]]
